passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Mucuna sloanei Fawc. & Rendle.

The native range of this species is S. Mexico and S. Florida to Tropical America, W. Tropical Africa to Angola. It is a liana and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome. It is used as a medicine, has environmental uses and for food.
